GET STARTED

Two ways into the Garage.

Use the framework and use individual artifacts are equally supported paths. Choose the smallest useful starting point.

PATH A

Use the framework

Build the current CLI from source and initialize the project configuration.

build from source
git clone https://github.com/bdonaldharris/builder-garage
cd builder-garage
go build ./cmd/garage
cd /path/to/your/project
/path/to/builder-garage/garage init

Requires Go 1.27.4. The CLI configures project settings and installs embedded skills, but it does not execute workflows or configure agents.

PATH B

Use individual artifacts

Download a skill, preserve its directory structure, then place it in the directory your agent harness supports.

ToolSkill location
Claude CodeProject or user skill directory
CodexProject or user skill directory
Copilot CLIProject or user skill directory

Browse skills

Skills are reusable procedures, not standalone executables. Read their requirements before adopting them.

What exists today

Available: a source-build CLI, 6 reusable skills, 3 provisional manuals, operating model, review contract, governance and documentation.

Not available: published releases, agent orchestration, provider integration, remote services, SDKs or plugins.
